title: Papyrus 5.99.0 cost tags do not deploy: data stack hits a CloudFormation limit
description: 2026-11-09: Machines on Machines job 80 (app d260vp72hqglnc) rolled the data stack back (UPDATE_ROLLBACK_COMPLETE, production unchanged) with 'Limit on the number of resources in a single stack operation exceeded' on about 60 table nested stacks: the cost tags touch every table in one deploy. Also the backend refuses to build without the Amplify branch variable PAPYRUS_SITE_ID unless the app-shell stack was deployed first (set by hand on Machines on Machines). Fix: apply the tags in smaller steps (stagger nested stacks, or several releases), and make a site build without PAPYRUS_SITE_ID fall back or fail with a clear step. Machines on Machines is pinned to 5.98.0 until fixed; the article rail, concepts row and citations to our own stories wait for it.
